cadastre.warning: Current cadastral geometry is compared with 2022 imagery; changes may be temporal.

imagery.rights: Croatian public-sector data (City of Zagreb CDOF 2022; state DOF likewise), paid by the taxpayer and free for research use including model training; verified by the project owner on 2026-10-12
imagery.source: City of Zagreb CDOF 2022 WMS tiles from the zagreb-parkiralista JPEG cache (quality 85, 1024 px, same grid as the spike GeoTIFFs); the frozen training-pool and held-out tiles keep the spike export

rules: training pool only: selection and final tiles are the frozen manifest's and never appear here
every pool tile is at least 500 m from every selection and final tile and shares no parcel source id with them
exhausted spike tiles outside the frozen training pool are left out
the frozen 96 training-pool tiles are included unchanged, so a 96-tile subset of the pool is a random draw and the frozen pool itself remains available through the frozen manifest
